# uptimeify_customer (Data Source)

Look up one customer by exact name. Fails when no or several visible customers have that name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_customer" "shop" {
  name = "Example Shop GmbH"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric customer id, e.g. for `customer_id` of a monitor.
- `public_id` (String)
- `status` (String) `active` or `inactive`.
